# Nagarjuna Reddy Kamireddy (Nagarjuna Kamireddy / Nagarjuna K)

> Lead AI Architect | AI Solutions Architect | GenAI Lead — Agentic AI & RAG · Available Immediately. 22 years in enterprise data platforms, SAP BW/BPC/HANA consulting, and production Machine Learning & Agentic AI across India, Malaysia, Singapore, the UK, and the US.

Nagarjuna Reddy Kamireddy (also published as **Nagarjuna Kamireddy**, **Nagarjuna K**, and **Nagarjun Reddy Kamireddi**) most recently served as AI Architect & Technical Lead (official title: Senior Data Scientist) at **John Deere** (`01/2023 – 10/2026`), where he owned architecture, a self-service AWS Terraform deployment platform, and delivery for a **12+ member team across 23+ AI initiatives** — delivering **750K+ automated requests and 42K+ hours saved in FY26**. He holds **AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional (SAP-C02)** and **NVIDIA-Certified Professional: Agentic AI (NCP-AAI)**, founded **Surya HANA Academy** (~1,000 professionals trained), runs an **Agentic AI Engineering programme** for working IT professionals, and maintains **15 curated flagship open-source AI repositories** at `github.com/nagarjunak-pixel`.

## 15 Curated Flagship Open-Source Repositories (`github.com/nagarjunak-pixel`)

- [`enterprise-erp-odata-mcp-server`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/enterprise-erp-odata-mcp-server): SAP S/4HANA and enterprise ERP Clean-Core OData v4 JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP server enforcing EDM schema allowlists (MM/SD/FI/MM-IM), C++20 $filter sanitization and row-level BUKRS authorization, IBAN/Tax-ID PII masking, human-approved write gates, and hash-chained audit logs (98.05% branch coverage).
- [`enterprise-helpdesk-rag-guardrails`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/enterprise-helpdesk-rag-guardrails): Enterprise help-desk hybrid retrieval and guardrail system combining pre-retrieval RBAC filtering, C++20 Okapi BM25 + L2 cosine + RRF fusion, code-enforced low-confidence abstention, PII/injection filters, and a 25-case automated acceptance suite (98.10% branch coverage).
- [`aegis-runtime`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/aegis-runtime): Policy and audit runtime for AI-agent tool execution featuring a custom capability DSL, segregation-of-duties enforcement, PII tokenization vault, compensating rollback sagas, and an Ed25519 hash-chained Merkle audit ledger.
- [`prism-gate`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/prism-gate): OpenAI-compatible multi-tenant LLM gateway implementing TCP-Vegas adaptive concurrency limits, per-tenant token budgets, latency/cost model cascades, and PSI/JSD distribution drift checks.
- [`vecta`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/vecta): Vector and lexical search engine implementing filtered HNSW with tombstone support (0.999 Recall@10 touching 1.4% of vectors), 24x IVF-PQ asymmetric distance computation, 1-bit RaBitQ quantization, BM25+RRF fusion, and native C++20 distance kernels.
- [`syntara`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/syntara): Constrained decoding engine compiling JSON Schema and regular expressions into minimal byte DFAs (Thompson/Rabin-Scott/Moore) with a native C++20 prefix-sharing token index and byte-level Earley CFG constraints (20/20 schema-valid structured outputs).
- [`governed-member-services-agent`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/governed-member-services-agent): Governed multi-tenant healthcare member-services workflow with deterministic tool authorization, grounded source citations, human escalation paths, and a 40-scenario CI regression harness.
- [`calibra`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/calibra): Statistical LLM evaluation library providing paired bootstrap and exact McNemar tests, Bradley-Terry arena leaderboards with confidence intervals, 2PL IRT anchor scoring, temperature scaling, and C++20 MinHash-LSH contamination checks (99.6% test coverage).
- [`verispec-sdd`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/verispec-sdd): Executable SPEC.md compiler with a C++20 CSR reachability, co-reachability, deadlock, and Tarjan SCC livelock prover plus zero-eval() AST guards and Hypothesis/Vitest property-test synthesis (98.01% branch coverage).
- [`skillbench`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/skillbench): Static information-flow taint analyzer, OOXML/ZIP/.pyc de-obfuscator, and C++20 Aho-Corasick multi-pattern scanner auditing agent SKILL.md bundles and .mcp.json configurations in CI (97.97% branch coverage).
- [`weavegraph`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/weavegraph): Dependency-aware git worktree scheduler using C++20 Tarjan SCC condensation, min-cut multi-agent task partitioning, and 3-way AST semantic merge verification to prevent cross-branch signature and contract breaks.
- [`tracegit`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/tracegit): Content-addressed version control for AI agent execution trajectories backed by a SQLite/SHA-256 Merkle DAG, C++20 edit-distance trace diff and regression bisection, periodic loop detection, and MCP tools.
- [`company-os`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/company-os): Declarative (company.json) multi-agent operations runtime coordinating 7 role-scoped agents across offline deterministic simulation and live OpenRouter modes with a web Kanban board and KPI engine.
- [`llm-knowledge-base`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/llm-knowledge-base): Source ingestion, compiled Markdown knowledge wiki, full-text search, and cited question-answering workspace built with FastAPI and SQLite.
- [`enterprise-ai-field-guides`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/enterprise-ai-field-guides): Practitioner reference library of 13 technical field guides (12-page deep dives) and executive monographs covering Production Hybrid/GraphRAG, SAP S/4HANA Clean-Core OData MCP, Agent Evaluation (255 CI checks), Supply-Chain Security, Multi-Cloud AI Gateways, and Forward-Deployed Engineering.
